name: @lablaunchpad/agent-sdk-repo
description: Standalone, local-first AI Agent SDK. Monorepo root.

scripts.context:check: pnpm tools:build && node scripts/repo-tools/dist/cli.js context check
scripts.context:refresh: pnpm tools:build && node scripts/repo-tools/dist/cli.js context refresh
scripts.facts:write: pnpm tools:build && node scripts/repo-tools/dist/cli.js facts write
scripts.verify: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test && pnpm validate && pnpm smoke
